Sri Lanka Court Convicts 15 Over 2019 Easter Bombings

A Sri Lankan court has found 15 men guilty in connection with the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings, which killed 279 people. Investigators had blamed the attacks on a homegrown Islamist extremist group. The verdict was delivered by a Sri Lankan court.
